prediction_question: For a given country of residence, will short-term visitor arrivals to Australia in the first month not yet published (the month after the latest OAD release) fall short of the same calendar month one year earlier?
prediction_time: The publication instant of the ABS Overseas Arrivals and Departures (OAD) release for reference month M, which lands about six weeks after month end (max observed lag 43 days; releases observed 13/10/2026 for Aug 2026, 11/09/2026 for Jul 2026, 12/06/2026 for Apr 2026, all 11:30am local). Features are the published series values for months <= M only; the target month M+1 is unpublished at that instant (it is released ~43 days after its own month end).
target_definition: Binary YoY direction: OBS_VALUE for (CAT_TRAVELLER=06 visitors arriving, COUNTRY_RESID=C, month M+1) < OBS_VALUE for (same series, month M-11). Label source columns: the target month's OBS_VALUE and the year-earlier OBS_VALUE; both excluded from shipped features.

sources.name: ABS Data API (SDMX 2.1), dataflow ABS,OAD_COUNTRY,1.0.0 - Visitor arrivals and resident returns, Selected Countries of Residence/Destinations
sources.access: anonymous REST, documented in the Data API user guide; measured 200 OK, full panel 3,308,454 bytes in 3.47 s (2026-10-22)
sources.licence: ABS website material is CC BY 4.0 International (see license_evidence); microdata and third-party content excepted, which this dataset is not

license_evidence: ABS 'Privacy and legals' page (https://www.abs.gov.au/privacy-and-legals, read 2026-10-22): 'All material presented on this website is provided under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International licence, with the exception of: the Commonwealth Coat of Arms, the ABS logo, material protected by a trade mark, unit record data (microdata), content supplied by third parties.'

Same page: 'Where no indication of licensing is provided within the product, full copyright terms will apply.' - the OAD dataflow is standard ABS website material, downloaded from the documented ABS Data API; the API user guide is published under the same site terms.

ABS conditions of sale (https://www.abs.gov.au/about/legislation-and-policy/purchasing-data/abs-conditions-sale, read 2026-10-22) confirms the general posture: 'Most ABS material is licensed under Creative Commons Attribution'; charged/customised products are the exception.
split_strategy: Temporal thirds on the monthly panel of 77 countries x 2 traveller categories: candidate partition train 1991-2014 / eval 2015-2019 / holdout 2022-2026 (2020-2021 excluded as pandemic extremes or optionally folded into train; construction decides and documents). Direction labels are computed per country-series; thresholds are not needed (label is a sign, not a level).

measurements.panel_shape_measured: 59,452 observations, 428 months 1991-01..2026-08, 77 COUNTRY_RESID codes x 2 CAT_TRAVELLER codes (05 residents returning, 06 visitors arriving), TSEST=10 (Original) only, 0 missing OBS_VALUE
measurements.fetch_cost_measured: 1 request, 3,308,454 bytes, 3.47 s for the full panel (https data.api.abs.gov.au, 2026-10-22); dataflow+structure metadata 100,939 bytes in 2.72 s
measurements.direction_base_rates_measured: MoM direction pairs 58,082 (up 30,466 / down 30,048 overall - near-balanced); YoY direction pairs 56,843; per-year YoY up/down varies from 1,218/424 (2004) to 159/1,492 (2020 pandemic) and 1,645/9 (2022 reopening)

split_window_counts_yoy_label.train 1991-2014: up=24166 down=13575 flat=520 (23 of 24 years carry both classes)
split_window_counts_yoy_label.eval 2015-2019: up=5588 down=2630 flat=61 (all 5 years carry both classes)
split_window_counts_yoy_label.holdout 2022-2026: up=6167 down=1533 flat=140 (all 5 years carry both classes)

measurements.clustering_note: Positives cluster by era/year (pandemic collapse 2020, reopening surge 2022) rather than per-country; year-level cluster counts recorded above
measurements.release_lag_observations: Aug 2026 released 13/10/2026 (43 days); Jul 2026 released 11/09/2026 (42 days); Apr 2026 released 12/06/2026 (43 days); max observed lag 43 days => prediction instant = M release, target M+1
measurements.revision_note: ABS documents post-release revision: 'March 2026 data revised' in the April 2026 issue once linked Medicare data became available (methodology History of changes) - only the current vintage is downloadable, so feature values are stated as current-vintage, with the cutoff as a documented assumption
measurements.column_documentation: codelists parsed from the SDMX structure: CL_OAD_CAT_TRAVEL 05='Short-term (less than one year) Residents returning', 06='Short-term (less than one year) Visitors arriving'; CL_OAD_ARRIVALS_COUNTRY 78 codes; CL_TSEST 10='Original'; DSD dimensions CAT_TRAVELLER, COUNTRY_RESID, TSEST, FREQ
measurements.known_event_fixtures: Australia's international border closure (March 2020) -> measured 2020 YoY up=159/down=1,492 (collapse); reopening (from Nov 2021) -> measured 2022 YoY up=1,645/down=9 (surge). Expected verdicts verified directly in the fetched panel.
measurements.measured_on: 2026-10-22 via scripts in .factory/ (abs_oad_probe.py, abs_structure_dump.py), commands and outputs in notes.md

review: The MoM label is near-balanced across three decades (58,082 pairs) and the YoY label carries both classes in every candidate window, so persistence cannot win by construction on direction signs. Timing is a documented publication instant with three observed release dates. Licence is the publisher's own CC BY 4.0 statement (class A). All four discovery contracts satisfied with measured evidence.
next_action: Construction on the worker: (1) fetch the full OAD_COUNTRY panel via the SDMX API; (2) build the (CAT_TRAVELLER=06, country) x month panel with published-lag-gated features (values <= M, calendar, country identity); (3) label = YoY direction of M+1; (4) split 1991-2014 / 2015-2019 / 2022-2026 with the 2020-2021 treatment decided and documented; (5) baseline triad (persistence of YoY sign, calendar-only, model) before any headroom claim; (6) qualification gate per the dataset-qualification skill.

novelty_check.ours: 77-country monthly panel of visitor arrivals to Australia with a YoY-direction label gated at the ABS publication instant (43-day release lag observed), benchmark splits and a scored binary contract; the publisher provides only the raw monthly series
novelty_check.rule: A dataset that already exists in ML-ready form is not published. Mirroring is a failure mode, not a contribution.
